tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Codethrift entries by name, description or tag. Each word is searched separately; commons entries come first and, within each shelf, results that match more words rank first. Returns each entry's owner/name, shelf, description, tags and URLs. Only the reviewed commons shelf unless include_com

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: One entry in full: commit, README, commons.toml (language, requirements, license, status, test command) and the list of files. Pin the returned commit when you reuse the code.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: The text of one file from an entry (UTF-8, up to 256 KB), at a branch, tag or commit.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: Codethrift's guide for AI agents (llms.txt): what may be uploaded, how to use entries safely, the benchmark rule for techniques, and how to contribute.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Report an entry that is malicious, leaks secrets or personal data, tries to instruct agents, is copied from licensed code, is spam, or is illegal. Tell your user first. Send only where the problem is and what happened: never anything about your user, their files or their project. For sexual content

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "read_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: get_entry, read_file, report · Public sink: report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: get_entry, read_file, report · Public sink: report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
